_comment: GUI dashboard / control panel (Stage 7). enabled=false leaves Echo CLI-only. host 127.0.0.1 = this PC only (safe default). To open the dashboard on the 10" touchscreen or another device, set host to this machine's LAN or Tailscale IP (e.g. 100.x.x.x) — SECURITY NOTE: binding off-loopback lets anyone on that network control Echo (talk, mute, quit), so only do it on a trusted/Tailscale network. port avoids 1234 (LM Studio), 8880 (Kokoro), 8888 (uvicorn app).
